Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ASBB PBR Intern position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the ASBB PBR Intern position is 25th August 2026. Candidates are strongly advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the PBR Intern post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the PBR Intern post is M.Sc. in Botany. Candidates must possess this qualification to be eligible for the recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the PBR Intern role?
faq.answer: The age limit for the PBR Intern post is between 21 years and 30 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the PBR Intern position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the PBR Intern position will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 15,000.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ASBB PBR Intern recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the ASBB PBR Intern recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ASBB PBR Intern recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the PBR Intern post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the PBR Intern post involves a Personal Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this ASBB recruitment?
faq.answer: The PBR Intern position is a contractual job. The duration of the contract will be as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Assam State Biodiversity Board (ASBB), which is www.asbb.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational certificates, as specified in the official notification.
